context: A teen catches up with her aunt about saving allowance
purpose: Teach: まじめ/貧乏/ときどき/ついつい/おまけ/パンツ/ふえ/やってくる

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくら、久しぶり。最近まじめにお小遣い貯めてるって聞いたよ。
lines.en: Sakura, long time no see. I heard you've been seriously saving your allowance lately.
lines.style: Warm aunt voice, gentle teasing tone, soft.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、頑張ってる。でも貧乏だからすぐなくなっちゃう。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm trying. But I'm broke so it disappears right away.
lines.style: Teen girl pouting, slightly whiny, casual.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ときどきカフェ行ったりしてるんじゃない?
lines.en: You're going to cafes sometimes, aren't you?
lines.style: Knowing aunt tone, playful suspicion, light.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ばれた…ついついタピオカ買っちゃうの。おまけにシール付いてくるし。
lines.en: Busted… I just can't help buying bubble tea. Plus they come with stickers.
lines.style: Embarrassed teen giggle, guilty confession, sheepish.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あはは、シール!でも下着とかパンツも自分で買うようになったって?
lines.en: Haha, stickers! But I heard you started buying your own underwear and pants too?
lines.style: Aunt laughing warmly, motherly curiosity, soft.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そう、自分のお金で買うと出費がふえて大変。
lines.en: Yeah, when I buy with my own money the expenses pile up and it's tough.
lines.style: Teen sighing dramatically, mature realization, weary.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 大人の世界へようこそ。請求書がやってくる日も近いよ。
lines.en: Welcome to the adult world. The day bills come knocking is close too.
lines.style: Aunt teasing wisely, mock-ominous warning, amused.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やめて〜怖いこと言わないで!
lines.en: Stop it~ don't say scary things!
lines.style: Teen protesting playfully, exaggerated horror, lively.
